Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about our cryptocurrency exchange service.

❓ What is SimpleSwap Exchange Canada?

SimpleSwap Canada is a user-friendly cryptocurrency exchange platform that allows Canadian users to buy, sell, and swap digital assets instantly without registration. The platform offers over 1000 cryptocurrencies and supports both floating and fixed rates for flexibility. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced trader, SimpleSwap makes crypto easy and accessible.

🇨🇦 Is SimpleSwap legal and safe to use in Canada?

Yes, SimpleSwap operates legally in Canada and complies with the local regulatory environment. It doesn't store your funds, making it less vulnerable to hacks. Your transactions are secure thanks to SSL encryption and integration with trusted crypto liquidity providers. Additionally, no KYC (Know Your Customer) process is required for most swaps, giving you enhanced privacy.

🔄 How do I exchange cryptocurrency on SimpleSwap?

  • Choose the crypto pair you want to swap (e.g., BTC to ETH)
  • Enter the amount and select between floating or fixed rate
  • Provide your receiving wallet address
  • Send your crypto to the provided address
  • Wait a few minutes – and your new coins arrive directly in your wallet!

It's that easy – no need for registration, verification, or complicated steps.

💰 Can I buy cryptocurrency with Canadian Dollars (CAD)?

Yes! SimpleSwap supports fiat-to-crypto purchases using CAD. You can buy popular cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and more using your credit or debit card. The payment gateway is PCI DSS-compliant, ensuring your personal and financial data is protected during the transaction.

📱 Does SimpleSwap have a mobile app for Canadians?

Absolutely. SimpleSwap offers a mobile app for both Android and iOS, making crypto trading easy on the go. The app features all the same functionality as the desktop version, including real-time price charts, transaction history, and multi-currency support.

🧾 Do I need to create an account to use SimpleSwap?

No, one of SimpleSwap's core features is its no-registration model. You can swap cryptocurrencies instantly without creating an account. This reduces the risk of identity theft and gives you full control over your transactions.

⚖️ What is the difference between floating and fixed rates?

Floating Rate:

You get the current market rate, which may fluctuate during the transaction.

Fixed Rate:

You lock in the rate at the beginning, avoiding market volatility.

SimpleSwap supports over 1000 cryptocurrencies, including:
